title: Vacuous foreign-seed assertion in announce store tamper test
description: announce_store.rs store_rejects_tamper_and_wrong_sealing_seed tampers the state record and never restores it before the foreign-seed (seed 0x43) assertion. The tampered record fails signature verification for ANY seed, so foreign.load() == Err(Corrupt) passes even if sealing were not bound to the node seed at all — the test proves nothing about seed binding. Fix: restore the original record (write_record_raw) or use fresh roots before the foreign-seed check. Found by correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-12zy.
close_reason: VERIFIED FIXED in tree — no code change needed. store_rejects_tamper_and_wrong_sealing_seed (rust/lichen-node/src/announce_store.rs:594-639) already implements exactly the requested fix: restores the original sealed record via write_record_raw (:616) before the foreign-seed check, asserts the restored record loads under the CORRECT seed 0x42 (:622), asserts Err(Corrupt) under foreign seed 0x43 (:628), then re-verifies under 0x42 (:633-635) proving the foreign failure is seed-specific. The vacuous-assertion hole (tampered record fails for ANY seed) is closed by the restore + correct-seed load assertions. Test passes (57/57 announce lib tests). No files touched, so no codereview passes required. Also verified stale this round with evidence comments: er31 (NOT_FOR_US filter present at link_layer.rs:1176-1180) and 4j1y (longest-prefix selection present at tunnel_auth.rs:398-449).
